text: Handling deadlines well starts with good time management. First, make a clear plan and decide which tasks are most important through prioritization. Focus on urgent work first, and don't waste time on small details. Scope management is also key: if a project is too big, reduce it to fit the time you have. Finally, communication matters. If you see a problem, tell your team or manager early. Don't wait until the last minute. By planning ahead, choosing priorities, controlling the size of tasks, and speaking up, you can meet deadlines with less stress and do better work.
